title: seizure-like EEG burst
task: One EEG channel: 24 raw samples (1.5 s) streamed in one 15-bit word per strobe -> seizure-like burst yes/no.
signal: 24 samples at 16 Hz (6-bit signed, about 5 uV per unit) of AR(1) background noise; the event is a 3 Hz spike-and-wave burst of 12-22 units from a random onset; 30 % of normal windows carry a slow blink-like bump.
model_size: layers [24, 8, 1], 200 weights (ternary hidden, 5-bit output layer); input 24 lanes x 6-bit signed
data: Synthetic data from a seeded generator, not patient data; the detection figures are on synthetic test windows and make no clinical claim.
